verdict.rationale: The only hints of API versioning are a versioned OpenAPI file path (v1/openapi.yaml in the PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi repo), a published changelog, and Classic-to-Billing migration guides, which point to some managed evolution of the API. Nothing in the pack describes a versioning scheme or a deprecation policy. Missing for 10: an explicit API versioning scheme (e.g. version headers or pinning), a documented deprecation policy with timelines or notice periods, and evidence of breaking-change handling beyond the Classic migration.
